text:
nina (AE): Heads-up: large regulated customer asked if we can do a 2-week air-gapped POC. Key asks: couriered media, customer-held signing keys, 30-day critical patch SLA, and price for extra minibundles. Need quick ops + pricing answers.

omar (SE): We recommend delta minibundles (<=2GB chunks) and a signed manifest. Provide a verification CLI that writes audit logs. If they hold keys, they sign manifests; we only ship tools. Rollback plan: snapshot+restore scripts, RTO ~1h.

ben (Customer-Sec): Confirm: no outbound egress from our cluster. Chain-of-custody proof and export classification required. Also, prefer HSM-held keys.

karin (PS): Pricing: base POC (1 bundle + remote support) = $10k. Extra minibundle = $1.5k each (includes media prep & manifest). Onsite eng per week = $3.5k. Emergency hotfix retainer (30d) = $5.5k. Shipping/insurance passed through.

logistics-bot: Shipping options: economy 7-10bd, expedited 2-3bd. Media prep $500, customs docs $200, declared value fee 1.2%. Add 2bd for export review.

nina (AE): Action items: 1) @omar draft runbook + verify CLI sample (ETA 3bd). 2) @karin send pricing sheet with two variants (weekly deltas vs monthly monolith). 3) @ben to share export/classification contact.

ben (Customer-Sec): Will share SQ answers and export contact today. Thanks. :thumbsup:
